hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: A Century of Bengaluru's Enduring Taste
hero.subtitle: Since 1920, Central Tiffin Room has been the heart of Old Bengaluru, serving iconic Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies.

about.title: Central Tiffin Room: The Heartbeat of Old Bengaluru
about.paragraph1: CTR, known affectionately as Central Tiffin Rooms, is more than just an eatery; it's a legendary institution woven into the very fabric of Old Bengaluru's history. Incepted in 1920, Central Tiffin Room has proudly delighted generations of patrons for over a century with its iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a rich array of South Indian delicacies. Our commitment to authentic flavors ensures that these timeless favorites continue to captivate people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: The rich legacy of Central Tiffin Room, meticulously crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and diligently carried forward by Mr. Sanjeev Poojari, Mr. Sandesh Poojari, and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory. Truly 'The Emotion That Holds Old Bengaluru Together,' we continue to deliver 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose,' retaining the same enchanting taste that has mirrored the boundless love and support of our patrons for over 104 years.
